title: ELIZA source code and DOCTOR script documented
summary: MIT Libraries preserves a 1965 archival item described as a complete printout of the source code listing of ELIZA, written in the MAD-SLIP programming language, with the DOCTOR script attached.
significance: Primary archival evidence establishes that ELIZA software and its DOCTOR script were documented in 1965 without requiring a more precise invention, completion, or public-release date.
